svg.title: Layers of a hardened Drupal site
svg.desc: Six stacked layers from the network edge to day-to-day operations, each with the controls the page describes.

g.text: HTTPS redirect, HSTS, proxy headers (X-Forwarded-Proto, HX-Request), firewall or CDN rules
Deny dotfiles, vendor PHP, PHP in files/, install and update scripts; security headers; trusted host names
Read-only code, writable files/ only, private files outside the docroot, zend.assertions = -1, errors hidden
hash_salt from the environment, trusted_host_patterns, update_free_access off, super user disabled, argon2id
Least-privilege roles, two-factor authentication, careful text formats, registration by administrators only
Security advisories, composer audit, tested backups, logs, an incident-response routine
A failure in one layer should be contained by the layers beneath it.
